# 2 Chronicles 13 — Disagreement Log

**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

## V.7

- **PNEUMA:** "A gang of worthless troublemakers rallied around him and overpowered Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young and indecisive, unable to resist them."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

## V.9
- **EMET:** "Did-not you-drive-out priests-of YHWH sons-of Aaron and-the-Levites and-you-made for-yourselves priests like-peoples-of the-lands every-one-who-comes "
- **LOGOS:** "Have you not driven out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves like the peoples of other lands? "
- **PNEUMA:** "Haven't you driven out the LORD's priests, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites? Haven't you appointed your own priests the way pagan nations do? Anyone"

## V.13
- **EMET:** "And-Jeroboam brought-around the-ambush to-come from-behind-them and-they-were before Judah and-the-ambush was-from-behind-them."
- **LOGOS:** "Jeroboam had sent an ambush around to come upon them from behind. Thus his troops were in front of Judah, and the ambush was behind them."
- **PNEUMA:** "Meanwhile, Jeroboam had secretly sent troops to circle behind them. So his main force faced Judah from the front while the ambush waited behind them."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

## V.17
- **EMET:** "And-he-struck against-them Abijah and-his-people a-striking great and-they-fell slain from-Israel five-hundred thousand men chosen."
- **LOGOS:** "Abijah and his people struck them with great force, so that 500,000 chosen men of Israel fell slain."
- **PNEUMA:** "Abijah and his troops inflicted heavy casualties — 500,000 of Israel's best soldiers fell that day."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

## V.20
- **EMET:** "And-not retained Jeroboam strength anymore in-days-of Abijah and-He-struck-him YHWH and-he-died."
- **LOGOS:** "Jeroboam did not recover his power in the days of Abijah. And the LORD struck him, and he died."
- **PNEUMA:** "Jeroboam never regained his power during Abijah's lifetime. The LORD struck him down, and he died."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
